        s = 0

        if not r:

        c = matrix[depot][r[0]] + matrix[r[-1]][depot]
        for i in range(len(r) - 1):
            c += matrix[r[i]][r[i + 1]]
        return c

    def total_cost(routes):
        s = 0
        for r in routes:
            s += route_cost(r)
        return s

    def is_feasible_route(r):
        return route_load(r) <= capacity

    def try_best_insert(route, node, pos_limit=None):

        if pos_limit is None:
            L = len(route)
            positions = range(L + 1)
        else:
            L = len(route)
            positions = pos_limit

        base_load = route_load(route)
        if base_load + demands[node] > capacity:
            return None, None

        best_c = None
        best_r = None

        L = len(route)
        for pos in positions:
            # insert node at index pos
            if L == 0:
                new_c = matrix[depot][node] + matrix[node][depot]
            else:
                if pos == 0:
                    new_c = matrix[depot][node] + matrix[node][route[0]]
                    old = matrix[depot][route[0]]
                    # replace dep->route[0] with dep->node->route[0]
                    new_c += (route_cost(route) - old)
                elif pos == L:
                    new_c = matrix[route[-1]][node] + matrix[node][depot]
                    old = matrix[route[-1]][depot]
                    new_c += (route_cost(route) - old)
                else:
                    a = route[pos - 1]
                    b = route[pos]
                    new_c = (route_cost(route) - matrix[a][b]) + matrix[a][node] + matrix[node][b]
            if best_c is None or new_c < best_c - 1e-9 or (abs(new_c - best_c) <= 1e-9 and node < node):
                best_c = new_c
                best_r = route[:pos] + [node] + route[pos:]
        return best_r, best_c

        # Deterministic first-improvement 2-opt within a single route
        L = len(route)
        if L < 4:
            return route, False
        cur = route_cost(route)
        best_r = route
        improved = False
        # Limit to keep deterministic and fast
